testcases.title: Admin-only enterprise settings pages return an Access denied panel.
testcases.navigation: Sign in as a non-admin enterprise Member, then visit enterprise settings
preconditions: A non-admin enterprise Member session is captured in .auth/member.json

steps.action: As a Member, visit each admin-only enterprise settings route.

assertions: every admin-only route renders the Access denied panel
no admin page chrome leaks through the gate

testcases.title: Enterprise admin APIs reject the member's own bearer token.
testcases.navigation: Sign in as a non-admin enterprise Member, then visit enterprise settings
preconditions: A non-admin enterprise Member session is captured in .auth/member.json

steps.action: Capture the member's bearer token from its own request, then replay it against admin-only enterprise endpoints.

assertions: each admin-only endpoint responds 403 for a member token

steps.action: Replay the member's token against the enterprise organizations endpoint.

assertions: the response contains only organizations the member belongs to
